severity_rationale: Meets C4 Medium criteria: 'value leak with stated assumptions and external requirements.' Legitimate emissions budget (rewardBudget) is permanently stranded after a schedule expires with no dispatcher inflow and no owner topUp, violating the documented feature-spec intent that windows auto-restart on pull. Stated assumption: a zero-stake tail occurs before windowEnd, or schedule expires while dispatcher mint-debt is zero. External requirement: no owner topUp during the gap. No direct asset theft (stakers never held title to that surplus), but real phUSD is locked with no on-chain recovery path, and the protocol's advertised emission continuity is broken. Not High because the stranding is not an attacker-controlled theft path and requires idle time plus a specific ordering of states. Not Low because the value at stake (up to rewardRate * zero-stake duration + floor-division residuals) is non-dust and the behavior contradicts explicit spec intent.
title: Budget stranded post-expiry when schedule expires with no dispatcher inflow; zero-stake gaps feed the stranding
description: Two cooperating root causes permanently strand rewardBudget: (1) _applyAsymmetricWindow is only invoked by _syncBudget AFTER the `inflow == 0 return` early exit. So if dispatcherHook.pull() returns zero (steady-state, no mint-debt) and no owner topUp has happened, _syncBudget exits before reaching _applyAsymmetricWindow. Once windowEnd has passed, the schedule stays expired; emissions clamp to windowEnd via `end = min(now, windowEnd)` in _updatePool, and no new emissions occur. (2) Zero-stake periods preserve rewardBudget (correctly avoiding reward loss) but windowEnd continues ticking. When stakers return, remaining runway is (windowEnd - now) at rewardRate but rewardBudget can be much larger than rewardRate * (windowEnd - now). Combined with (1), the surplus is then stranded at expiry with no inflow path to trigger the reset branch that would redistribute it.
attack_path: 1) Owner tops up B = 540d * rate. windowEnd = now + 540d. 2) All stakers unstake at t = windowEnd - 1d. During the 1-day zero-stake tail, _updatePool skips accrual and just bumps lastRewardTime; rewardBudget is unchanged. 3) Block.timestamp advances past windowEnd. Dispatcher hook has no mint debt to pull (steady state). 4) A new staker stakes. stake() -> _syncBudget() -> _updatePool() (elapsed clipped to 0 since end=windowEnd <= lastRewardTime) -> pull() returns 0 -> early return. _applyAsymmetricWindow is NOT called. Schedule stays expired; rewardRate still nonzero in storage but currentRewardRate() returns 0 (windowEnd in past). rewardBudget holds the leftover ~1d * rate of phUSD forever. 5) Only an owner topUp (amount > 0, real tokens moved in) can reset the schedule.
impact: Leftover budget from a prior window — expected to roll into the next 540-day schedule automatically on the next interaction per the intended design — is instead silently stranded. Stakers who expected continuous emissions stop receiving anything until an owner manually tops up. Magnitude equals cumulative untouched budget at expiry: up to rewardRate * (duration of zero-stake gaps) per cycle, plus floor-division residuals from extend-branch rounding. Violates the explicit intent that windows auto-restart on pull.
recommendation: Move the reset on scheduleExpired out from under the `if (inflow == 0) return;` guard. Two concrete options: (a) inside _syncBudget, call _applyAsymmetricWindow(0) when the schedule has expired AND rewardBudget > 0, regardless of inflow; (b) have _updatePool itself trigger a schedule reset when block.timestamp >= windowEnd and rewardBudget > 0. Alternatively, allow pullAndRefresh to force a schedule reset independent of inflow. Additionally, when _updatePool detects a zero-stake gap (totalStaked == 0, elapsed > 0), consider shortening windowEnd by elapsed to keep rewardBudget / remainingWindow proportional to the originally-set rate.

sanitization.rationale: Root cause is _syncBudget control flow and _updatePool zero-stake handling in NFTStaker.sol. Directly contradicts feature spec item 5 intent ('emissions continue against the existing schedule').
